verdict.rationale: BVNK documents a broad, Hawk-authenticated API. It covers wallets, virtual accounts, payouts, transfers, payment rules, pay-in simulation, webhooks and reports. The docs explicitly say wallets can be created and managed 'through the Portal or API'. That parity statement is limited to wallets; no source claims the API matches everything the Portal can do. missing for 10: an explicit platform-wide API/UI parity statement, evidence that Portal-only features (e.g. account settings, user management, markup and reporting configuration) are exposed via the API, and independent hands-on corroboration.
